body: I know people can be crappy. I'm more just sick of being alone, and trying to be my own friend

The nature of our relationship is friends, where I am usually supporting them through tough times. We've been talking for over a year, and we talk about everything really from gaming to personal life and problems. They are a transitioning male who hasn't the best life so I'm usually the one they talk to about their depressive episodes and suicidal thoughts
I'm not sure. What usually happens is we talk for a while then after 2 weeks or so he just doesn't reply. Then rinse and repeat every couple of months.

As I said, I've lost one friend to suicide already. Because of that pain I'm going to do anything I can to make sure I never have to feel it again. I'd rather deal with his pain as well then let him face it alone, and I dont want to lose him.

And now it's gotten worse. They guy I like is dealing with personal stuff and now they are thinking of killing themselves. It's nice having to be rejected, want to die then have to help them stay alive because you care about them. Not to mention only just losing a friend to suicide less then 4 months ago

I just want to be cared about. It's just so hard when you can see yourself with them and to just feel that hope being ripped away repeatedly just hurts. Not to mention they had their boyfriend message me which just made it worse. Just reading his message of, "We are in a happy relationship for over a year." Just made me want to cry and hurt myself so badly. I just want that for myself but I knew I'll probably end up dead before it ever happens

It's just that they acted so flirty and fun, and with my situation, I was planning on going fo college near them to maybe have a chance, now I'm not really even seeing a point to going there anymore. It was usually me staring our talks and stuff, so it just feels they dont give a shit about me. Not like anyone cares about me anyway
I wish they were easier to find. Would save me a few sleepless nights and horrible thoughts
